summary: Phase 7 backend tests for Mini Accounting (suppliers/purchases credit-note flow, customer+supplier outstanding/ledger reports, multi-cheque/multi-allocation payments, Resend forgot/reset with inline-OTP fallback). 18/18 tests pass. All critical behaviours verified end-to-end against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Token delivered via HttpOnly cookie only; response body does not contain access_token/token. Tests relying on body token must use requests.Session + cookies (OK for current flow, but document this contract for clients outside the browser).

critical_code_review_comments: reports.py is 661 lines - consider splitting per report family (customer, supplier, financial, payments) into separate modules for maintainability.
routes/invoices.py is 431 lines and starting to host migration helpers (auto-creating linked purchases inside create_invoice). Consider extracting migration logic into a dedicated service module.
_credit_total helper is duplicated in suppliers.py, reports.py, purchases.py (as _enrich_purchase). Extract to a shared module (e.g., routes/_helpers.py) to keep credit-note math consistent.

recalc_invoice_status in payments.py still counts supplier-destination returns because the $match on db.returns doesn't filter by destination. Customer-bound returns should reduce invoice outstanding; supplier-bound credit notes should NOT. Verify and add {'destination': {'$ne': 'supplier'}} to the aggregation.

supplier-payable (/api/reports/supplier-payable) aggregates supplier payments by entity_id via total amount, which is consistent; however supplier-outstanding/{id} uses allocation-level 'paid' per purchase. A supplier payment without allocations will appear as unpaid at the purchase level but paid at the summary level — potential inconsistency for users reading both reports.
email_service Resend fallback correctly returns OTP inline when the sandbox key rejects non-verified recipients — flow works as documented.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest session creates TEST_ prefixed supplier, customer, product (UUID-suffixed), one purchase (600), one invoice (500). Supplier returns / payments created inside tests are cleaned up where possible; some TEST_ prefixed supplier/customer/product/purchase/invoice remain in the DB (harmless, prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full regression test file is /app/backend/tests/test_phase7.py. Auth is cookie-based: use requests.Session() and the cookie jar, or use /api/auth/me to verify. Resend with the sandbox key only delivers to commercialtrading079@gmail.com; for admin@example.com OTP is returned inline (email_sent=false, otp=...). Critical invariant enforced by tests: POST /api/returns with destination=supplier MUST NOT mutate purchases.total_amount; the credit is tracked on supplier_return_adjustments and exposed via credit_notes_total / net_payable. DELETE /api/returns/{id} on a supplier return must reverse the adjustment entry without touching total_amount.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures after initial login-assertion fix (login returns only user body; token in HttpOnly cookie). Updated test to assert via cookie + /api/auth/me.
